title: The Seal
notes: The chapter assembles the seal as Name-plus-law with high density, chaining signet, forehead plate, frontlets, inkhorn, Spirit impression, and beast counterfeit without padding. Law-positive voice and OT-to-Revelation continuity are strong; the two engravings on 2 Timothy 2:19 and the sabbath as full royal signet land cleanly. Residual defects are presenter staging cues, three author-prose sentence opens on And/That, and the spelled count against house digit style. No quote corruption, doctrine invention, or broken internal math. Surgical open and cue removals restore the asserted register.

proposals.old: Now read Revelation with the plate in view: the hundred forty and four thousand stand with the Lamb, __“having his Father's *name* written in their *foreheads*”__ (Revelation 14:1) — a kingdom of priests, every one wearing the plate.
proposals.new: Revelation with the plate in view: the 144,000 stand with the Lamb, __“having his Father's *name* written in their *foreheads*”__ (Revelation 14:1) — a kingdom of priests, every one wearing the plate.
proposals.summary: Remove director cue and apply house digit count.
proposals.rationale: “Now read” is forbidden presenter staging. House style requires digits for counts such as 144,000.

proposals.old: And the book's last page makes it the estate of all His servants: __“they shall see his face; and his *name* shall be in their foreheads”__ (Revelation 22:4).
proposals.new: The book's last page makes it the estate of all His servants: __“they shall see his face; and his *name* shall be in their foreheads”__ (Revelation 22:4).
proposals.summary: Drop leading And in author prose.
proposals.rationale: Author sentences may not open with And. Dropping it preserves the claim and the following scripture block.

proposals.old: Note which way the true seal faces.
proposals.new: The true seal faces the other way.
proposals.summary: Replace Note cue with direct assertion.
proposals.rationale: “Note which” is a forbidden director cue. The replacement keeps the contrast that follows without meta instruction.

proposals.old: That is the whole difference between the seals: one names an owner who keeps you; the other brands what it will spend.
proposals.new: The whole difference between the seals is this: one names an owner who keeps you; the other brands what it will spend.
proposals.summary: Eliminate leading That in author prose.
proposals.rationale: Author sentences may not open with That. Rephrasing retains the exact contrast and density.

proposals.old: And the seal has a common form every man has carried in his pocket — refined metal struck with an image and a superscription, an owner's name made money.
proposals.new: The seal has a common form every man has carried in his pocket — refined metal struck with an image and a superscription, an owner's name made money.
proposals.summary: Drop leading And before the coin bridge.
proposals.rationale: Author sentences may not open with And. The claim and the next-chapter turn remain intact.
